segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בּוֹר שֶׁל שְׁנֵי שׁוּתָּפִין; עָבַר עָלָיו הָרִאשׁוֹן וְלֹא כִּסָּהוּ, וְהַשֵּׁנִי וְלֹא כִּסָּהוּ – הַשֵּׁנִי חַיָּיב.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If «a pit belonging to two partners» was uncovered and «the first» partner «passed by it and did not cover it, and» then «the second» passed by it «and did not cover it, the second» is «liable» for any damage caused by means of the pit.

moves.summary: the second partner who failed to cover is liable

positions.claim: when both partners pass without covering, the second is liable
